meta.title: Religiosity
meta.question: How religious are Poles?
meta.measure: Average religiosity, from 0 (not at all religious) to 10 (deeply religious)
meta.anchor: Pooled from every question on how religious people are: believing, how religious they consider themselves, the importance of God and religion, and prayer, with every answer placed on 0 to 10 and the trend read on the scale of an average question.

items.wording: How important is God in your life? (1 not at all ... 10 very)
How important in your life is religion? (very, quite, not, not at all important)
Are you a religious person, not a religious person or a convinced atheist?
items.notes: EVS 1990, 1999, 2008, 2017. Very skewed in Poland (about 90% religious).

items.wording: Degree of religiosity: religious and following the Church's teaching (10), religious in my own way, cannot say, not religious (0)
items.notes: CDCEE 1991 and 2000. Code 5 (not religious because the churches are wrong; 4 Polish respondents) and 6 (other) are left without a position; the pipeline allows one code at 0.

items.wording: Regardless of religious practice, do you consider yourself deeply believing, believing, rather non-believing or completely non-believing?
items.notes: CBOS, 1992-03 to 2017-12, the standard metryczka question (275 surveys). In 1992-07 to 1993-12 the second category reads "rather believing" instead of "believing": the end labels are the same, so those months are pooled here.

items.wording: Strength of religious faith: deeply believing, believing, non-believing
items.notes: PGSS 1992-2010 (10 waves). Coarse: about 80% say "believing".

items.wording: How important are religion and the Church (in your life)? 1 unimportant ... 7 very important
items.notes: PGSS 1992-1997 (5 waves); part of a life-domains battery.

items.wording: Regardless of religious practice, do you consider yourself deeply believing, believing, undecided or non-believing?
items.notes: CBOS, 1992-05 and 1993-11 to 1995-10 (about 18 surveys): the variant with "undecided" and "non-believing" in place of "rather/completely non-believing".

items.wording: Which statement comes closest to your belief about God? (I don't believe in God ... I know God really exists; ISSP)
items.notes: PGSS 1993 (en22) and 2010 (re16), whole sample.

items.wording: How often do you pray? (never ... several times a day, 11 categories)
items.notes: PGSS 1994-2010 (8 waves). re27 (ISSP 1999 and 2010) is the same question and is not used, to avoid counting 2010 twice.

items.wording: Which statement about belief in God is closest to you? (I believe in God and have no doubts ... I do not believe in God; ISSP wording)
items.notes: CBOS 1997-03, 2008-12, 2009-02, 2013-07, 2015-02. EXCLUDE 2013-04, 2013-05 and 2013-06 (exclusions.csv): there the question was asked only of a subsample selected on the believer question (fewer than 100 respondents each), and the label cannot tell those surveys apart.

items.wording: How important in your life is religion? (very, rather, not very, not at all important)
items.notes: WVS 1989, 1997, 2005, 2012. In 1989 about a third of the Polish file is missing on this item (coded "missing; not available").

items.wording: Are you a religious person, not a religious person or a (convinced) atheist?
Attitude to religious faith: non-believer, has doubts in matters of faith, believer, deeply religious
items.notes: PGSW 1997-2015 and 2023 (not asked in 2019).

items.wording: How often do you pray to God outside religious services? (every day ... never)
items.notes: EVS 1999, 2008, 2017. The 1990 version (often, sometimes, hardly ever, only in times of crisis, never) is left out: its order is unclear.

items.wording: Belief in God (ISSP), as above; the top category is coded 8 in this wave
items.notes: PGSS 1999, ISSP religion module: half of the sample (the ISSP ballot).

items.wording: Would you describe yourself as extremely religious ... extremely non-religious? (7 points)
items.notes: PGSS 1999 (ISSP ballot, half the sample) and 2010 (whole sample).

items.wording: Strength of religious faith: very religious, somewhat religious, not very religious, no religious beliefs
items.notes: PGSW 2000 presidential study (single survey).

items.wording: Belief in God (ISSP statements, believe without doubt ... do not believe)
items.notes: PGSW 2000 presidential study (single survey).

items.wording: How important is religion in your life: very, somewhat, not too or not at all important?
items.notes: Pew 2002, 2005, 2007-2013, 2015-2019, 2022-2025 (19 surveys). 2025 was by telephone, every earlier wave face to face: a candidate for a mode split.

items.wording: Apart from at religious services, how often, if at all, do you pray? (every day ... never)
items.notes: ESS rounds 1-11. Prayer kept here rather than with attendance: see the notes.

items.wording: Regardless of whether you belong to a particular religion, how religious would you say you are? (0-10)
How important is God in your life? (1-10)
Outside of attending religious services, do you pray several times a day, once a day, a few times a week, once a week or less, or never?
items.notes: Pew 2007, 2008, 2009 (spring and fall), 2010-2013, 2015 (9 surveys). Very uneven: "once a week or less" is the modal answer.

items.wording: How often, roughly, do you pray? (every day, more than once a week, once a week, at least once a month, several times a year, once a year, less than once a year, never)
Regardless of whether you belong to a particular religion, how religious would you say you are? (0-10)
items.notes: EES 2009 (Poland).

items.wording: Religiosity self-assessment: deeply religious, religious, undecided but attached to tradition, indifferent, non-believer
items.notes: POLPAN 2013 (about 7% not asked in their questionnaire version) and 2018.

items.wording: Outside of religious services, do you pray several times a day, once a day, a few times a week, once a week, a few times a month, seldom/less often, or never?
items.notes: Pew 2017, 2024, 2025 (the 2018, 2019 and 2023 versions were not asked in Poland). 2025 by telephone.

items.wording: Apart from at religious services, how often, if at all, do you pray? (every day ... never)
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: Regardless of whether you belong to a particular religion, how religious would you say you are? (0-10)
items.notes: ESS round 10 (2021-22): self-completion by web and paper in Poland, where every other round was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: Outside of religious services, do you pray several times a day, once a day, a few times a week, once a week, a few times a month, seldom/less often, or never?
items.notes: Pew spring 2025: by telephone in Poland, where every earlier wave was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: How important is religion in your life: very, somewhat, not too or not at all important?
items.notes: Pew spring 2025: by telephone in Poland, where every earlier wave was face to face, so a question of its own.

items.wording: Do you consider yourself deeply devout, a believer, rather non-believing or completely non-believing?
items.notes: PGSW 2025 presidential study; the CBOS four categories, not PGSW's "has doubts" scale.

items.wording: Regardless of denomination, how would you describe your degree of religiosity? (0-10)
items.notes: FNW SWPS survey Dec 2025 (online).

items.wording: Regardless of denomination, how would you describe your degree of religiosity? (0 not at all religious ... 10 very religious)
items.notes: BDCS survey, Poland, 2025 (online, single survey).

items.wording: To what extent do you consider yourself a believer? (deeply non-believing ... deeply believing, 7 points)
items.notes: FNW SWPS survey May 2026 (online).
